summary: Confirmed 2026 nightly rates $40 (30-amp) / $45 (50-amp) and full hookups with 50-amp; added the camp store. Operator pages state no season (2026 activities run May 23 - Sept 6; about two dozen frost-free sites rent monthly through winter), no site count, no booking method beyond phone/contact form, and no dump station (left derived).
